else.note: m: the same person's other case (design). Bayes factor 0.4.

exact.note: u: one in a million, order of magnitude of the case numbers in use (about 5,000 federal criminal cases a district-year x 94 districts x 20 years = 9.4 million). m: 60% of true-match pairs share the case (design: a person may have several cases and a document may cite another).

conflict.note: m: a person recorded in another state (design). u: candidates are gathered by state, so this is rare; neutral (Bayes factor 1) until labels say otherwise.

exact.note: m: a person recorded in the same city in two documents (design). u: a namesake in the same city, about 2% of those in the same state (sum of squared city shares, order of magnitude).

same_county.note: m: moved within the county (design). u: a namesake in another city of the same county.

same_state.note: m: moved within the state (design). u: the default for a namesake in the same state.

conflict.note: m: a recorded date of birth or age that disagrees with the same person's: the 2% data error of the Splink guide plus the day-month typographical remainder (Winkler 2006), 3%. u: the remainder.

exact.note: u: 1 / (365.25 x 30), a flat 30-year birth range (Splink theory guide: about 10,000 dates). m: an assumed half of true-match pairs compare two dates of birth (design; the other half involve an age), times 0.857 = 0.95^3, the day, month and year each at the 5% typographical error rate of Winkler 2006 = 0.43, rounded up to 0.45 (the Splink guide's 98% exact agreement is the upper bound).

within_1.note: u: 3 of 30 years (a gap of at most 1) less the exact share. m: true-match pairs with an age, which agree to within a year when recorded without error (design: the other half of pairs).

within_3.note: u: 7 of 30 years less the inner levels. m: the remaining true-match share (design).

exact.note: Name agreement adds no evidence: the prior is computed for the row's name and every candidate is gathered by it, so m = u (Bayes factor 1).

jaro_winkler.note: Approximate name agreement is weaker than exact; a one-bit penalty (Bayes factor 0.5) until labels replace it.

nickname.note: Approximate name agreement is weaker than exact; a one-bit penalty (Bayes factor 0.5) until labels replace it.

conflict.note: m: the 10% typographical error rate for a name field, Winkler 2006, used as the rate of a recorded middle name that disagrees. u: the remainder.

exact.note: m: 1 - the 10% first-name typographical error rate (Winkler 2006) less the share of true matches where one source gives only an initial (design, 20%). u: assumes about 100 effective distinct middle names (sum of squared shares), to be replaced by the SSA sum when the files are imported.

initial.note: m: true matches where one source records an initial only (design, 20%). u: about 17 effective initials (sum of squared shares ~ 0.06).

double_metaphone.note: Approximate name agreement is weaker than exact; a one-bit penalty (Bayes factor 0.5) until labels replace it.

else.note: No agreement on the surname at all: Bayes factor 0.25. Candidates are gathered by surname, so this level is rare (an alias pair).

exact.note: Name agreement adds no evidence: the prior is computed for the row's name and every candidate is gathered by it, so m = u (Bayes factor 1).

jaro_winkler.note: Approximate name agreement is weaker than exact; a one-bit penalty (Bayes factor 0.5) until labels replace it.

description: Provisional m and u for the identity evidence model, built from the literature and arithmetic alone. Replaced by identity.params.labeled_pairs once 150 pairs are labeled.
